content:
Enjoy the convenience of cashless shopping with SBI Platinum International Debit Cards and earn SBI Rewardz points on your purchases. With your SBI Platinum International Debit Card you get access to your account whenever and wherever you want. You can use it to purchase goods at merchant establishments, for making payment online and withdraw cash in India as well as across the globe.
Features
(Available on RuPay / MasterCard / VISA)
For shopping at over 52 Lakh merchant outlets in India, and over 30 million worldwide
For booking movie tickets, bill payments, travel and other online purchases and payments over the internet.
For withdrawing cash from SBI ATMs or other ATMs in India and worldwide
Safe online shopping and e-commerce transactions.
SBI Platinum Cards are one of the select variants of the Cards having complimentary airport lounge access subject to Terms & Conditions applies.
State Bank Debit Card Loyalty Program:
Earn up to 10,000 SBI Reward Points every month with a cap of Rs. 1,000/- per transaction.
Standard Reward:
Earn 2 Reward Points per Rs.200 spent with your SBI Platinum International Debit Card, online or in-store, on shopping, dining out, fuel, travel and more.
Activation Bonus:
Earn up to 300 Bonus Reward Points on making 3 payments with your new SBI Platinum International Debit Card, online or in-store, within 2 months of issuance with minimum transaction of Rs.2000/-
1st Use- 50
2nd Use- 100
3rd Use -150
Milestone Bonus:
Earn 1,000 Bonus Reward Points on PoS and E-comm spends of ₹1 lakh or more in a month. (Spends on MCC-6540 excluded)
Birthday Bonus:
Earn 2x Reward Points on spends made with your Debit Card during your birthday month.
International Payments:
Earn 2x Reward Points on international spending, online or in-store.
Partner Brands:
Earn extra Reward Points on every purchase at Loyalty program partner brands, online, in-store and via SBI Rewardz.
Redeem Reward Points: You can redeem your SBI reward point through our website "rewardz.sbi", SBI REWARDZ App, Yono App and RINB.
Recharge & Bill Payments:
No matter your monthly bill - mobile recharge, DTH, electricity, gas or FASTag, pay through Bharat Bill Pay with your Reward Points and save every month.
Movie Tickets:
Cinema just got more special! Redeem your Reward Points on Book My Show and save on every movie ticket.
Merchandise & E-vouchers:
Explore and save on a range of home & kitchenware, décor, electronics, pooja items, gifting options and more fun shopping.
Travel:
Save on every flight, bus, and hotel booking by redeeming your Reward Points.
Compare & fly for great deals
No convenience fee
Partner Brands:
Redeem Reward Points on every purchase at Loyalty Program partner brands, online, in-store and via SBI Rewardz.
